subject: world_language
concept: Naming days of the week in the target language
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student sequences physical day-of-week cards in order while saying each in the target language
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a day-of-week word to its position on a simple calendar
exercise.abstract: Student names the day that comes before or after a given target-language day name

misconception_flags: places days of the week out of order

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
target_language: configurable — student/parent selects target language at enrollment
